uwp_capture_status: partial: uwp-app-runner returned ok:true (process/window alive) but the original UWP app hung on the SDK 'Universal Windows Platform sample' extended-splash screen across two fresh launches (20s settle); MainPage never presented and the CoreWindow content pane stayed empty in the UIA tree, so golden frames show only the splash and no UWP feature controls could be captured or actuated. No live UWP behavioral baseline; scored against the source-derived checklist + UWP source + visual judgment of the WinUI frames.
notes: WinUI 3 migration renders both scenarios fully (non-blank frames, anyFrameRendered=true), navigates between them, and reproduces the SDK sample layout faithfully. Compare-Parity = 100/100 with 2/2 scenarios and full control coverage (Data Events 2/2, Polling 1/1). Action controls invoke successfully (Enable, Get Data invokeOk=true; Disable correctly starts disabled) but produce no altitude reading because this machine has no altimeter sensor; the app correctly shows the 'No altimeter found' defensive fallback. That no-output is hardware-gated (the original UWP app would behave identically on this hardware), not a dead control, so it is not a downgrade. No UWP behavioral golden was obtainable (UWP stuck on splash), so live sensor behavior is unverifiable on both sides.

features.name: Scenario 1 - Data Events
features.note: Full structural coverage (2/2: Enable, Disable). WinUI renders header, scenario list, description, Enable/Disable buttons (Disable disabled until Enable), 'Altitude change(m): No data', and 'No altimeter found' status. Enable invokes (invokeOk=true) but yields no reading — hardware-gated (no altimeter), matching the app's correct fallback. UWP baseline unavailable (stuck on splash); uwp_responded=false reflects that no UWP golden response could be observed, not a UWP regression. Visual fidelity to the SDK sample layout confirmed on the rendered WinUI frame.

features.name: Scenario 2 - Polling
features.note: Full structural coverage (1/1: Get Data). WinUI renders header, scenario list, description, Get Data button, 'Altitude change(m): No data', and 'No altimeter found' status. Get Data invokes (invokeOk=true) but yields no reading — hardware-gated (no altimeter), matching the app's correct fallback. UWP baseline unavailable (stuck on splash). Visual fidelity to the SDK sample layout confirmed on the rendered WinUI frame.
